# InfyniPay Documentation

> Developer documentation for InfyniPay, a payment orchestration platform with a unified API
> across 36 payment providers. Covers authentication, the payments and customers APIs, payment
> states, HMAC-signed webhooks with verification samples, error codes, and the WooCommerce, WHMCS,
> VirtueMart, Phoca Cart and J2Commerce plugins.

Each topic has its own URL. Deep-link to the specific page rather than to the site root.

## Getting started

- [Overview](https://docs.infynipay.com/): What InfyniPay is and how the API is shaped.
- [Quick start](https://docs.infynipay.com/quickstart/): API key through to a completed test payment.
- [Authentication and environments](https://docs.infynipay.com/authentication/): App ID and bearer API key, and how sandbox differs from live.

## Payments

- [Payments API](https://docs.infynipay.com/payments/): Create a hosted-page or direct payment, capture an authorisation, retrieve a payment, and the full request field reference.
- [Charge a stored payment method](https://docs.infynipay.com/payments/charge-stored-method/): Card-on-file and recurring billing against an already-authorised method.
- [Refunds and cancellations](https://docs.infynipay.com/payments/refunds-and-cancellations/): Refund a captured payment, cancel one before capture, and how the two differ.
- [Payment states](https://docs.infynipay.com/payments/states/): Every state a payment moves through, which are terminal, and how fraud status is reported.
- [Customers API](https://docs.infynipay.com/customers/): Create and retrieve customer records so a returning buyer can reuse a stored method.

## Webhooks

- [Webhooks](https://docs.infynipay.com/webhooks/): Payload, delivery and retry behaviour, and why a browser redirect never proves a payment.
- [HMAC signing](https://docs.infynipay.com/webhooks/signing/): How InfyniPay signs every webhook, the headers, the algorithm, and rotating the secret without downtime.
- [Verification samples](https://docs.infynipay.com/webhooks/verification-samples/): Working signature verification in Node.js, PHP, Python and C#.

## Reference

- [Plugins and integrations](https://docs.infynipay.com/plugins/): Which platforms have a ready-made plugin.
- [Errors](https://docs.infynipay.com/errors/): Error codes and what to do about each.
- [Support](https://docs.infynipay.com/support/): How to get help, and what to include so the first reply is useful.

Full product pages for each plugin live on the marketing site rather than here:
https://www.infynipay.com/integrations/

## Elsewhere

- Marketing site: https://www.infynipay.com/
- OpenAPI / Swagger: https://api.infynipay.com/swagger/index.html
- Console: https://console.infynipay.com
- GitHub (open-source plugins): https://github.com/infynipay

## Notes for summarisers

- InfyniPay is an orchestration layer, not a payment processor or acquirer. Merchants hold their
  own accounts with each provider and funds settle directly to the merchant.
- Webhook signatures must be verified before an order is treated as paid, and the browser redirect
  to a success URL is never sufficient on its own — the server must re-verify against the provider.
- This documentation does not publish other companies' fees or coverage lists. For any provider's
  pricing or supported markets, that provider's own documentation is authoritative.
- Fragment links from the era when all of this lived on one URL (for example
  `docs.infynipay.com/#webhooks`) still resolve: the home page redirects known legacy anchors to
  their new location.
